subject: Your slider at 11PM
preview_text: One tiny tweak that made my midnight podcast listening 3x better — no ads, no fuss.
body_paragraphs: Last night, at 11PM, I put on a podcast. The volume was just a notch too low. In the old app, I’d have suffered through an ad to boost it. Not tonight.
I opened Volume Booster Pro, dragged the slider to 150%, and hit play. No interstitial. No pop-up. Just louder, cleaner audio. The whole thing took six seconds.
That’s the trick: the slider works instantly, system-wide. Set it once, and it remembers. Next time you plug in headphones, it’s already there, waiting, silent.

Try it now: open the app, crank the slider to where it feels right, then start your next podcast or YouTube video. Notice how it just works. P.S. That same slider goes to 200% if you need it — no extra steps, no friction.
